---
name: Maintainer feedback
about: You maintain an OSS project and you're getting hit by AI slop reports
title: "[feedback] "
labels: maintainer-feedback
---

If you maintain an OSS project receiving AI-generated vulnerability reports, your input shapes how SlopGuard works.

A few things that would help (answer whichever you want, skip the rest):

- **Volume.** Roughly how many slop reports per week or month?
- **Patterns.** What are the most common patterns you see? (specific tools, specific phrasing, specific CWE classes always being claimed?)
- **What helps.** What would a triage tool need to do to actually save you time?
- **What hurts.** What would make such a tool actively worse than no tool?
- **Examples.** If you can share a sample slop report with PII redacted, attach it. It'll go into the public benchmark dataset (CC-BY) unless you say otherwise.

Anonymous is fine. If you want to discuss off-issue, mention it and we'll find a channel.
